target_year_over_year_context.explanation:
The complete selected original text is identical within the same SEC Item after removing line-leading bullet formatting and normalizing whitespace. Neither LLM agent was used for this link.

The 2023 disclosure (D251) defines 'Other income' which includes losses from tax-oriented investments (alternative energy) and associated tax credits. The 2024 disclosure (D213) describes the adoption of proportional amortization for these specific alternative energy tax-oriented investments, changing their recognition from Other income to Income tax expense. This is a direct evolution of the accounting treatment for the subject matter introduced in 2023.

comparisons.peer_topic: Adoption of ASU No. 2023-02 for Tax Credit Structures
comparisons.peer_summary: Citi adopted ASU No. 2023-02 effective January 1, 2024, allowing the use of the proportional amortization method for certain tax-incentivized investments, which had no material impact on the financial statements.
comparisons.comparison: Both JPM and Citi adopted ASU No. 2023-02 effective January 1, 2024, to use the proportional amortization method for tax-incentivized investments, resulting in amortization being presented in income tax expense rather than other income. However, Citi explicitly stated the adoption had no material impact on its financial statements, whereas JPM disclosed the specific change in recognition location from other income to income tax expense to align with tax credits.

sentences.text: Proportional Amortization Method: Effective January 1, 2024, as a result of adopting updates to the Accounting for Investments in Tax Credit Structures Using the Proportional Amortization Method guidance, the amortization of certain of the Firm's alternative energy tax-oriented investments that was previously recognized in other income is now recognized in income tax expense, which aligns with the associated tax credits and other tax benefits.

Under the proportional amortization method, the cost of an eligible investment is amortized in proportion to the income tax credits and other income tax benefits that are received by the investor, with the amortization of the investment and the income tax credits being presented net in the income statement as components of income tax expense (benefit).
Citi adopted the ASU on January 1, 2024, which did not have a material impact to the financial statements of the Company.

comparisons.peer_topic: Investment structure and accounting method for tax credit VIEs
comparisons.peer_summary: The firm invests in nonconsolidated tax credit VIEs via limited partnership interests to receive income tax credits and benefits. As of January 1, 2024, the firm adopted ASU No. 2023-02, electing the proportional amortization method for qualified affordable housing and renewable energy projects receiving production tax credits, with amortization and credits recorded in the provision for taxes.
comparisons.comparison: Goldman Sachs, like JPM, adopted ASU No. 2023-02 effective January 1, 2024, electing the proportional amortization method for qualified affordable housing and renewable energy projects. Both firms record the amortization and related income tax credits as components of income tax expense/provision. Goldman Sachs further specifies that these items are included in other operating activities in the cash flow statement, while JPM emphasizes the alignment with tax benefits in the income statement.

sentences.text: Proportional Amortization Method: Effective January 1, 2024, as a result of adopting updates to the Accounting for Investments in Tax Credit Structures Using the Proportional Amortization Method guidance, the amortization of certain of the Firm's alternative energy tax-oriented investments that was previously recognized in other income is now recognized in income tax expense, which aligns with the associated tax credits and other tax benefits.

In connection with the adoption of ASU No. 2023-02, as of January 1, 2024, the firm elected the proportional amortization method for qualified affordable housing and renewable energy projects that receive production tax credits.

The investments that meet the criteria for the proportional amortization method of accounting are amortized in proportion to the income tax credits and other income tax benefits received on such investments.

The amortization of investments and the related income tax credits and other income tax benefits are recorded as a component of the provision for taxes, and are included in other operating activities in the consolidated statements of cash flows.

comparisons.peer_topic: Adoption of Proportional Amortization Method for Tax Equity Investments
comparisons.peer_summary: The Firm adopted the accounting update for Investments - Equity Method and Joint Ventures - Tax Credit Structures on January 1, 2024, using the modified retrospective method, which permits electing the proportional amortization method for tax equity investments meeting certain conditions.
comparisons.comparison: Morgan Stanley adopted the accounting update on January 1, 2024, permitting the election of the proportional amortization method, similar to JPM. Both firms amortize the investment cost in proportion to income tax credits and recognize this net in the income statement as a component of income tax expense/provision. Morgan Stanley additionally notes the use of the modified retrospective method for adoption.

sentences.text: Proportional Amortization Method: Effective January 1, 2024, as a result of adopting updates to the Accounting for Investments in Tax Credit Structures Using the Proportional Amortization Method guidance, the amortization of certain of the Firm's alternative energy tax-oriented investments that was previously recognized in other income is now recognized in income tax expense, which aligns with the associated tax credits and other tax benefits.
The Firm adopted the Investments - Equity Method and Joint Ventures - Tax Credit Structures accounting update on January 1, 2024 using the modified retrospective method.
This accounting update permits an election to account for tax equity investments using the proportional amortization method if certain conditions are met.

Under the proportional amortization method, the initial cost of the investment is amortized in proportion to the income tax credits and other income tax benefits received and recognized net in the income statement as a component of provision for income taxes.
